activities.title: Espresso at Not Just Coffee
activities.description: Experience the precision of Charlotte’s specialty coffee scene in the heart of Uptown’s market. It’s a fast-paced, urban social hub perfect for a morning spark before exploring the city core.

activities.title: Stroll Through Independence Park
activities.description: Walk the winding paths of the city’s oldest park, recently renovated to blend historic charm with modern social spaces. It’s a serene, leafy baseline for a casual afternoon meet-up.

activities.title: Tacos & Neon at Papi Grande's
activities.description: Dive into a high-octane social dinner with coastal Mexican vibes and vibrant decor. It’s a loud, adventurous spot in LoSo that sets the tone for a big night out.

activities.title: Live Local Sets at The Gin Mill
activities.description: Get close to the stage for live acoustic acts and a bustling patio scene right on the Rail Trail. It’s a high-visibility social landmark where the energy stays peaked well into the night.

activities.title: Gaming & Tacos at El Thrifty
activities.description: Challenge friends to social games in a polished, upscale cantina setting within Optimist Hall. It’s an adventurous mix of competitive fun and high-quality cocktails in a massive industrial space.

activities.title: Sunset Sips at Sycamore Brewing
activities.description: Join the post-work rush at this massive South End anchor. The expansive beer garden and light rail proximity make it the ultimate social baseline for meeting people before the night begins.

activities.title: Precision Caffeine at Nightflyer Roastworks
activities.description: Fuel your Wednesday morning at this roastery known for its technical mastery and community focus. It’s a quiet, high-design space where the city’s creative professionals kick off their day.

activities.title: Mac & Cheese at JackBeagle's
activities.description: Cap off your Tuesday with a legendary bowl of spicy mac and cheese in the heart of NoDa. This gritty, welcoming spot is a baseline late-night sanctuary for locals and industry workers.

activities.title: Neighborhood Hang at Rhino Market
activities.description: Grab a signature sandwich and a local brew at this authentic urban bodega. It’s a social crossroads for the Wesley Heights community, perfect for a casual Wednesday afternoon transition.

activities.title: Social Gaming at Puttery
activities.description: Experience high-design indoor mini-golf paired with curated cocktails. The immersive, lounge-like atmosphere offers an adventurous social baseline for those who want activity with their drinks.

activities.title: Refuel at Flower Child
activities.description: Join the South End wellness crowd for a bright, health-conscious Wednesday lunch. The vibrant atmosphere and inclusive vibe make it a baseline social hub for the neighborhood's active residents.

activities.title: Darts & Drafts at Old Pineville Pub
activities.description: Discover the local secret of LoSo at this unpretentious neighborhood bar. It’s a reliable, low-key baseline for a Tuesday night involving local craft beers and a competitive game of darts.
activities.location: Old Pineville Premium Pub, Lower South End

activities.title: Patio Pints at Suffolk Punch
activities.description: Experience the massive hybrid taphouse and coffee bar right on the Blue Line. It’s a premier Wednesday evening social destination where the Rail Trail community converges for brews and small plates.

activities.title: Rooftop Brews at Giddy Goat
activities.description: Enjoy a morning roast or an afternoon pint on the expansive rooftop of this eclectic Plaza Midwood coffee house. It is a high-energy social hub perfect for meeting the city's creative class.
activities.location: Giddy Goat Coffee Roasters, Plaza Midwood

activities.title: Late Night Pizza at Benny Pennello's
activities.description: Grab a massive, legendary slice at this NoDa window as the bars start to clear out. It is the quintessential late-night food baseline for the neighborhood’s adventurous social crowd.

activities.title: Social Tennis at Jeff Adams Center
activities.description: Join a pick-up match at this massive public tennis facility known for its active and welcoming community. It is a foundational sports baseline for the city's fitness-focused socialites.
activities.location: Jeff Adams Tennis Center, North End

activities.title: Patio Pints at Pop the Top
activities.description: Settle in with a curated NC craft beer at this cozy, inclusive bottle shop and taproom. It is a welcoming social baseline for a relaxed transition from the afternoon into the evening.
activities.location: Pop the Top Craft Beer Shop, South End

activities.title: Boutique Retail at Moxie Mercantile
activities.description: Discover curated home goods and jewelry in this charming historic house turned shop. It is a baseline for finding unique, locally-sourced gifts in the vibrant heart of Plaza Midwood.

activities.title: Karaoke & BBQ at Seoul Food
activities.description: Feast on Korean-fusion BBQ before heading to a private karaoke room with your social circle. This venue is a South End staple known for its massive, playground-style outdoor patio.
activities.location: Seoul Food Meat Co, South End

activities.title: Social Games at Queen Park Social
activities.description: Compete in bowling, shuffleboard, and vintage arcade games in a sprawling warehouse setting. It is the go-to spot in LoSo for large groups seeking high-energy entertainment.

activities.title: Summit Coffee Highland Creek Run
activities.description: Join the Charlotte Running Club for a morning run through Highland Creek. A great way to start your day, meet fellow runners, and explore the neighborhood.
activities.location: Summit Coffee Highland Creek, Highland Creek

activities.title: Green Crown Program Relaunch
activities.description: The City of Charlotte is relaunching its Green Crown Program, now open to businesses in the restaurant, beverage, and hospitality industries. Learn about sustainable practices and network.
activities.location: Fonta Flora Brewery at Optimist Hall, Optimist Park

activities.title: SouthPark After 5: Java Band
activities.description: Enjoy a free outdoor concert featuring the Java Band as part of the SouthPark After 5 series. Bring a lawn chair and relax with live music.

activities.title: Thursdays on the Turf
activities.description: A free live music series in Commonwealth Plaza Midwood. Enjoy local bands in a relaxed outdoor setting, perfect for an evening unwind.

activities.title: Live Music Thursdays at Lore Brewing
activities.description: Head to Lore Brewing for a free evening of live music. Enjoy craft beers and a laid-back atmosphere with local talent.

activities.title: Plaza Midwood Chess Club Meetup
activities.description: Join fellow chess enthusiasts for a casual game night at Common Market. All skill levels are welcome for this free community meetup.
activities.location: Common Market Plaza Midwood, Plaza Midwood

activities.title: Board Game Night at Hi-Wire Brewing
activities.description: Gather your friends or make new ones at Hi-Wire Brewing's free board game night. Enjoy a wide selection of games and craft brews.

activities.title: Powerful Voices Open Mic Show
activities.description: Experience a diverse night of live music, comedy, poetry, and more at this open mic show. Discover local talent in an intimate setting.

activities.title: QDOBA Free Chips & Queso
activities.description: Celebrate the full moon with a free order of Chips & Queso from QDOBA with any full-size entrée purchase at participating locations.

activities.title: Free Birding Walks at Daniel Stowe Botanical Garden
activities.description: Start your morning with a guided birding walk on the beautiful trails of Stowe Conservancy. A peaceful way to connect with nature.

activities.title: Free Fun Fridays with YScholars
activities.description: Bring the little ones for a free morning of creative drama and fun activities at the Johnston YMCA. All are welcome for this family-friendly event.

activities.title: Free Public Tour of Innovation Barn
activities.description: Take a free weekly public tour of the Innovation Barn and learn about sustainable practices and circular economy initiatives in Charlotte.

activities.title: Food Truck Friday at Resident Culture Brewing
activities.description: Kick off your weekend with Food Truck Friday at Resident Culture Brewing. Enjoy a rotating selection of local food trucks and craft beers.
activities.location: Resident Culture Brewing Plaza Midwood, Plaza Midwood

activities.title: University City Food Truck Friday
activities.description: Head to Armored Cow Brewing for their Food Truck Friday event. A great way to sample diverse local cuisine and enjoy a relaxed evening.

activities.title: BOOM Charlotte Fringe Festival (Free Events)
activities.description: Explore the free components of the BOOM Charlotte Fringe Festival, featuring diverse arts, music, dance, and visual art installations.
activities.location: Shoppes at University Place, University City

activities.title: Finally Fridays Pop-Up at Urban District Market
activities.description: A monthly curated pop-up event with local shopping, karaoke, live entertainment, food trucks, and games. A lively way to spend your Friday evening.

activities.title: Friday Night Monarch Market Comedy Showcase
activities.description: Enjoy a free comedy show in Uptown Charlotte featuring top local and touring comedians. Reserve your spot for an intimate night of laughs.
activities.location: Monarch Market by Crescent Communities, Uptown

activities.title: River Jam: Evan Blackerby and the Bandwagon
activities.description: Catch Evan Blackerby and the Bandwagon live at the U.S. National Whitewater Center's popular River Jam series. Enjoy outdoor music with a parking fee.
activities.location: U.S. National Whitewater Center, West Charlotte

activities.title: Comedy Show at Sip City
activities.description: Catch a hilarious comedy show at Sip City's new event space. Featuring local and regional comedians, it's a perfect mid-week laugh.

activities.title: Steve Trevino Live at The Comedy Zone
activities.description: See comedian Steve Trevino, "America's Favorite Husband," perform live. Known for his relatable humor, this special event promises big laughs.
activities.location: The Comedy Zone - Charlotte, Music Factory

activities.title: Gavin Marengi & Co. at The Evening Muse
activities.description: Enjoy a night of live music with Gavin Marengi, Nathan C Davis, and Caroline Keller at the intimate Evening Muse. A great spot to discover new artists.

activities.title: River Jam at USNWC
activities.description: Experience the popular River Jam concert series at the U.S. National Whitewater Center. Enjoy live music by the river, with a small parking fee.
activities.location: U.S. National Whitewater Center, West Charlotte

activities.title: Harvey Cummings II, Soul-Inflected Jazz
activities.description: Immerse yourself in an evening of soulful jazz with Harvey Cummings II. This intimate performance at Middle C Jazz promises a sophisticated and relaxing night out.

activities.title: Steve Trevino Comedy Show
activities.description: Laugh out loud with 'America's Favorite Husband,' comedian Steve Trevino, known for his relatable humor. He's selling out shows nationwide, so grab your tickets for a night of top-tier stand-up.

activities.title: Karaoke Night with DJ Windsor
activities.description: Unleash your inner pop star at Bar Argon's fabulous queer karaoke night. Sing your heart out, dance, and celebrate in a safe and inclusive space with DJ Windsor.

activities.title: Survey Says Trivia at Canteen
activities.description: Test your knowledge and enjoy a fun-filled evening of Survey Says Trivia at Canteen in Camp North End. Gather your friends for a chance to win prizes and enjoy the vibrant atmosphere.

activities.title: Green Crown Program Relaunch Event
activities.description: Learn about Charlotte's revamped Green Crown Program, now open to businesses in the restaurant, beverage, and hospitality industries. This relaunch event at Fonta Flora Brewery is a great opportunity to network and learn about sustainable practices.

activities.title: Powerful Voices Open Mic Show
activities.description: Experience a diverse evening of live music, comedy, and poetry at the Powerful Voices Open Mic Show. Discover local talent and enjoy a night of creative expression.

activities.title: Wine Thursdays at Hex
activities.description: Enjoy $8 wine by the glass all day at Hex. It's a perfect opportunity to unwind and sample some great wines in a relaxed setting.

activities.title: Charlotte Cinco De Mayo Bar Crawl Party
activities.description: Kick off Cinco de Mayo early with Charlotte's biggest bar crawl party. Your ticket grants access to multiple participating venues and a final stop to close out the night.

activities.title: Kandace Springs Live at Middle C Jazz
activities.description: Enjoy an evening with the soulful and captivating Kandace Springs as she performs live at Middle C Jazz. Her unique blend of jazz, R&B, and pop creates an unforgettable musical experience.

activities.title: Finally Fridays: Asian Night Market
activities.description: PopCulture: A Limited Event Series presents 'Finally Fridays' with an Asian Night Market. Enjoy authentic cuisine, outdoor dining, local vendors, and karaoke in a lively atmosphere.

activities.title: Swagga First Friday Party
activities.description: Charlotte Nightlife Entertainment presents 'Swagga First Friday' at Sofie's Steakhouse. Get ready for a high-energy night of music, dancing, and good vibes to kick off the weekend.

activities.title: Friday Night Monarch Market Comedy Showcase
activities.description: Catch a free comedy show in Uptown Charlotte featuring top local and touring comedians. The intimate Aster event space at Monarch Market provides an exclusive experience, so reserve your spot.

activities.title: Bangzz Live at Snug Harbor
activities.description: Catch Bangzz live at Snug Harbor for a night of high-energy rock music. This is a great opportunity to experience Charlotte's vibrant local music scene.

activities.title: Trap Karaoke: Charlotte
activities.description: Get ready to sing your heart out at Trap Karaoke in Charlotte. This popular event at The Fillmore is a high-energy night where you can perform your favorite trap and hip-hop anthems.

activities.title: AfterDark 2026: SPLASH! Gala
activities.description: Join the Gay Men's Chorus of Charlotte for their annual 'AfterDark' gala, themed 'SPLASH!'. Expect delicious food, a superb bar, exciting auction items, and dazzling performances by their ensembles. This event promises glamor and glitz for a great cause.

activities.title: Kathy Griffin Live
activities.description: Catch the unfiltered and hilarious Kathy Griffin as she brings her stand-up comedy to Charlotte. Known for her sharp wit and celebrity takes, this is a night of no-holds-barred laughter.

activities.title: The Purpose Summit: NASCAR Hall of Fame Experience
activities.description: Day two of The Purpose Summit offers exclusive access to the NASCAR Hall of Fame. Engage in powerful breakout sessions, interactive team-building experiences like simulated racing, and full access to all exhibits.

activities.title: Chelsea Handler: The High and Mighty Tour
activities.description: Don't miss comedian Chelsea Handler on her 'High and Mighty Tour.' Known for her candid and witty observations, she's sure to deliver a night of unforgettable laughs.

activities.title: Charlotte Symphony Orchestra: Bach And Beyond
activities.description: Experience the Charlotte Symphony Orchestra performing 'Bach And Beyond' at The Carolina. This is a fantastic opportunity to enjoy classical music in a beautiful setting.

activities.title: Hey Charlotte! City Comedy Tour
activities.description: Embark on a unique sightseeing tour that blends sharp comedy, theatrical characters, and real Charlotte history. This custom bus tour offers an immersive and hilarious way to see the city.
activities.location: Camp North End (starting point), North End

activities.title: Music Bingo with Seabrooks
activities.description: Join the fun every Thursday for Music Bingo with Seabrooks. Enjoy good food specials, drinks, and a chance to win weekly prizes, including a grand prize of two tickets to Carolina Country Music Fest.

activities.title: Ultimate Drag Queen Bingo & Drag Show
activities.description: Experience the ultimate Drag Queen Bingo and Drag Show at Morton's The Steakhouse. This event combines hilarious bingo with dazzling drag performances for an unforgettable night.

activities.title: Kawaii Rave: 18+
activities.description: Dive into a vibrant and energetic Kawaii Rave at The Underground. This 18+ event promises a night of electronic music, colorful aesthetics, and an immersive dance experience.

activities.title: Charlotte Comedy City Tour
activities.description: Take a unique comedy tour of Charlotte, blending humor, theatrical characters, and local history. This bus tour offers a playful and immersive way to explore the city's stories.
